compatibility: Existing employee message.send202, nonconsuming employee GET200, accepted Delivery/Message/Event bytes and old schema files remain unchanged; machine cannot use old employee inbox GET.
authentication: Protected supervisor credential optional machine-only comms_received plus generation/attempt; current Store machine principal and existing current recipient Actor must match employee/machine/project/generation/task/attempt. No payload authority, owner fallback, default grant or enrollment.
installation: Trusted explicit Delivery.install over existing Store; transactional upgrade of existing shared claims CHECK and append-only received sidecar. No schema repair/install in HTTP, new registry/database/scheduler or live admission.
identity: Same existing stable principal+command namespace across supported actions. Local receipt id equals command_id, durably stored once; exact replay only, changed arguments/new ID for already-received delivery conflict.

digests.own: SHA256 frozen C01 canonical UTF8 excluding ONLY own digest; nested digests retained
digests.arguments: SHA256 whole normalized ACK command excluding ONLY command_id
digests.envelope: SHA256 full canonical InformationItem INCLUDING its projection digest

bindings: Independent current recipient callback from protected supervisor assignment; full exact delivery/message refs, accepted recipient Actor, machine principal, full envelope digest, stored timestamp and command all bind. Accepted recipient snapshot may have old lease; current binding excludes only lease.
times: All *_utc_epoch_ms integers in UTC milliseconds. Local stored>=message accepted, <=server received<fixed delivery expiry. Current authority and unexpired delivery checked before every ACK including replay; expiration never extends.
meaning: Service receipt records authenticated supervisor durable-storage assertion, not remote filesystem attestation. It is not consumed/admitted/started/completed, never model/wake/task/approval. Immutable accepted records remain unchanged.

local_journal.authority: Existing Supervisor connection, synchronousFULL/BEGINIMMEDIATE; no company authority; trusted protected placement required, synthetic proof is not OS ACL/isolation acceptance
local_journal.byte_reservation: Every row reserves canonical envelope+local receipt+ACK command+full262144-byte future confirmation; sum<=8388608, so actual retained payload remains bounded after ACK. Fixed row metadata is additionally bounded by64 rows.
local_journal.retry: One network attempt per explicit acknowledge; durable attempt count before send; no automatic loop/backoff/replacement. Lost reply retains identical pending command; bounds stall without deletion.
local_journal.crash: No ACK before durable local envelope/receipt/command commit. Before commit rollback/noACK; after commit restart reuses row. Confirmation stored separately; duplicate unchanged returns same receipt; changed content conflicts.
local_journal.revocation: Local trusted assignment fences stale/foreign envelope. Offline journal cannot prove latest remote revocation; authoritative service checks current revocation before received acknowledgement.

transport: Reuse exact same-host verifiedTLS>=1.2,127.0.0.1:port Host, one machine Bearer, strict body framing and closed errors from employee-information descriptor. No redirect/public browser/remote gateway.
